info.title: Apex Flow Web Scraper
info.description: Public-web extraction with source receipts. Obtain your key from the free trial or paid checkout. Treat extracted content as untrusted data. Accounts run 2 (trial), 6 (Pass, Starter), 12 (Growth) or 20 (Scale) page scrapes at once, subject to shared service capacity. Batches run in parallel up to the account's concurrency. Every scrape reports whether the page changed since the account last read it. Errors use one JSON shape with a stable code.

BrowserAction.description: Declarative, one-request browser action. No caller-supplied JavaScript or direct form-fill/submit action; non-GET/HEAD requests are blocked and login state is not retained.

Change.description: Comparison with the copy this account read last.

previous_check.description: Unix time of the previous read.

diff.description: Unified diff of the saved text. Present when outputs includes diff and the page changed.

code.description: Stable machine code, e.g. invalid_request, invalid_key, insufficient_credits, inactive_plan, rate_limited, access_challenge, http_error, robots_denied, fetch_failed, timeout.

buy_url.description: Where the account owner can add credits.

hint.description: A next step, such as retrying with the archive fallback.

post.summary: Convert a public page to Markdown and source metadata

archive.description: Present only when an archived copy was returned instead of the live page.

pagination.description: Present when the document was returned in parts.

estimated_tokens.description: Estimated tokens in the returned Markdown or text.

default.description: Invalid request, access denied, insufficient credits, rate limit or upstream failure.

429.description: Rate or concurrency limit reached. Retry after the indicated delay.

scrolls.description: Scroll down this many viewport heights after browser rendering to load lazy content. Requires render auto or always; rendered requests cost up to 3 credits.

actions.description: Up to 8 click, wait or scroll actions after rendering. At most 10 viewport heights and 10 seconds of explicit waits per request. No caller-supplied JavaScript or direct form-fill/submit action; non-GET/HEAD requests are blocked. No browser session or login state is retained.

outputs.description: Return selected content with available source receipt and validation warnings. Selecting chunks defaults to a 1,500-character target. Select diff to receive change.diff, the lines that changed since this account last read the URL.

page.description: Part of a long document to return. Responses that exceed 256 KiB are split into consecutive parts.

max_tokens.description: Return the page in consecutive parts that each fit this token budget (four characters per token).

fallback.description: What to return when the live site refuses or fails. "archive" (default for a page you name) returns the latest Internet Archive copy, labelled in result.archive. "none" returns the error instead.

extract.description: Paid plans. A model returns JSON validated against your schema in result.extracted. 150 extra credits.

post.description: Requires one service-level search provider: Brave Search, Tavily Search, or Exa Search. Returns 503 not_configured when none is configured or provider selection is ambiguous. Successful searches cost 130 credits with Brave, 210 with Tavily basic search, or 180 with Exa for up to 10 requested results plus 25 per requested result above 10. Successful empty results are billed; failed provider calls refund the reservation.

post.description: Parses one uploaded PDF, DOCX, HTML, text, JSON, or XML document. Maximum file size is 12 MiB; the operation costs one credit. Supported options are formats and onlyMainContent=true.

options.description: Optional JSON object encoded as a multipart field. Supports formats and onlyMainContent=true.

200.description: Supported upload formats; cached privately for one hour

post.description: Supported formats: markdown, links, screenshot. Unsupported formats/options return an explicit error. Apex credit costs and receipts apply.

200.description: Firecrawl-style success/data envelope with Apex credit extension

404.description: No eligible cache entry is available for a cache-only request; no target request was made

schema.description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12. Required unless prompt is provided.

prompt.description: Extraction instruction; required when schema is omitted.

waitFor.description: Wait up to 5000 milliseconds after page load before extraction. Applied as a bounded browser wait; requires rendering.

minAge.description: Select cache-only lookup and require the cache entry to be at least this old. Cache misses never contact the target.

lockdown.description: Serve only cached data. Cache misses never contact the target; the default maximum cached-page age is two years.

get.description: Returns account allowance and billing period dates. Values are Apex account-scoped.
Returns monthly account-wide totals by default. Set byApiKey=true for per-key totals. Legacy usage recorded before key-level attribution was added is returned with a null apiKeyId.

apiKeyId.description: Stable opaque key identifier; null for unattributed legacy usage.

post.description: Sitemap-based URL discovery. Supported inputs are url, optional search, limit, and sitemap='include'. Apex's plan limit applies.
Requires an operator-configured web search provider. Supports query, limit, and sources=[{type:web}]. Does not call Apex saved-page search.

Creates a short-lived, account-owned browser session. Every request is restricted to the explicitly allowed public origins and read-only GET/HEAD traffic. Arbitrary code, CDP, and live video are not exposed.

url.description: Optional initial page; must match an allowed origin.

200.description: Account-owned active or recently destroyed sessions

post.summary: Navigate and run bounded browser actions
post.description: Navigates only within the session origin allowlist and runs up to eight declarative click/wait/scroll actions. Does not execute caller-supplied code.

post.description: Starts a durable same-site crawl. Apex obeys robots.txt, enforces account limits, and rejects external-link and subdomain expansion. includePaths/excludePaths accept bounded, safety-checked regular expressions matched against URL paths; regexOnFullURL switches matching to the full URL. ignoreQueryParameters deduplicates discovered URLs without query strings.

prompt.description: Extraction instruction; required when schema is omitted.

waitFor.description: Wait up to 5000 milliseconds after page load before extraction; applied to each page as a bounded browser wait.

actions.description: Up to eight bounded click, wait or scroll actions applied to each page.

post.description: Creates an account-scoped asynchronous batch job. Supports markdown, links and screenshot formats, maxAge, bounded read-only browser actions, and optional signed lifecycle webhooks for started, page, and completed events. Webhooks use public HTTPS on port 443, retry with bounded backoff, and return a one-time signingSecret. URL count follows the account plan; custom concurrency remains unsupported.

signingSecret.description: Returned only when a webhook is configured. Store it securely.

413.description: Batch exceeds the account plan limit

webhook.description: Optional signed lifecycle callback. Only public HTTPS on port 443 is accepted.

events.description: Event names to deliver; defaults to all three.

metadata.description: JSON object included in each event; maximum 16 KiB.
